_doc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending, EVERY display string below. R28-2c (docs/REINTERP_R28-2_GUIDED_NARRATIVE_SPEC_2026-07-10.md §4): the belongings beat. 'Remind me later' on the T1 update notice (src/desktop/apps/update.ts, key u2) opens a gathering window; the player clicks eligible Room-1 props to KEEP them before the era turns (src/narrative/belongings.ts owns the state machine; src/engine/app.ts's BELONGINGS_HIT owns the click geometry, CLAUDE.md rail: geometry in .ts, text in data/). `eligible` is the data-driven set Fable chose (originally 5-8 small props, NOT desk/CRT/furniture per the rail): the mixtape (THE designed candidate, Tape C — already canon, never files under its OWN tape-outcome law but its keeping DOES file here, a separate act), tapeA/tapeB (the other two Session-30 cassettes), the plant, two book props, and the poster as the 'polaroid-ish decor' stand-in (no literal polaroid prop exists yet in Room 1). D33 (Session 34) ADDS teddyBox and rainbowDuck per explicit session brief instruction — now 9 items, past the original 5-8 range; flagged in the session log rather than silently exceeding it. `label` is the human-readable name substituted into `keptTemplate` at window-close (one line per kept item, e.g. 'kept: the mixtape'). `processedLine` files once, only on the Update-Now-DIRECT path (the gathering window never opened at all — spec §4 rule 3). The gathering-window PROMPT text itself ('departure scheduled...') and its own gathered/declined witness pair live in data/dialog/s1_guide.json's `belongings` side-message (reused EXISTING guide system, R28-2a) — this file does not duplicate that pair.

secondPass._doc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending. S2R.7 (Session 58): THE SECOND GATHERING, on the u3 notice — 'what do you take from THIS life?' Same room, six years on: the E1 pass was a teenager's departure, this one is an adult's MIGRATION, so the objects are the SAME objects (no new ids, no new click geometry — src/engine/app.ts's BELONGINGS_HIT already covers every id here, and data/room/reinterp_deltas.json's r2 fold moves none of them) and only the RECORD's phrasing changes. `eligible` is therefore the first-pass set MINUS tapeA/tapeB, which r2 removes from the room along with the boombox — an object that is not there cannot be taken. Ids already kept in the first pass are filtered out at runtime (src/narrative/belongings.ts): they are already frozen at their r1 fold and are not offered a second time. Labels are NOT duplicated here — they resolve from `eligible` above, so a label can never drift between the two passes.
